Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Ceramic Indoor Window Sill Planter Box Pot - 3 x 12 x 3 Inch, Green and Blue
Materials: Ceramic
This crisp, cool green and grey planter will add a beautiful touch of color to your window sill. The bottom of the piece is hand-painted, while the main body is fired with a reactive glaze, making each of these charming pieces unique. 3.35"D x 12"W x 3.15"H Designed to hold plants; does not have drainage Ceramic stoneware Fired with reactive glaze and hand-painted. No two will be exactly alike.
